title: A look at the investigations involving Nvidia, Jensen Huang and ...
description:
_Washington —_ Revelations that [Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-challenges/) with a woman alleged to be a Chinese intelligence asset have put the leading AI company under a microscope, as lawmakers and states question whether Nvidia skirted federal export rules that aim to stop its most advanced chips from going to China.

While Huang initially [resigned his post](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns/) amid scrutiny of [his relationship with Alice Huang](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jensen-huang-nvidia-resignation-scandal-timeline/), a former executive at the Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed, Nvidia's board of directors announced Monday that it [reinstated Huang as president and CEO](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nvidia-reinstates-jensen-huang-ceo/).

News of Huang's return to Nvidia sent shockwaves through the business and political worlds, even as [President Trump said he had spoken to the board](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-reinstated/) and "convinced them" to bring Huang back. The president [told CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/trump-nvidia-jensen-huang.html) in an interview that his administration gave Nvidia "assurances" that Huang is not a threat to national security.

Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk."

Still, investigations by at least one state and Congress are unlikely to be derailed by Huang's dramatic return to Nvidia.

## California Department of Justice
California Attorney General Rob Bonta served an investigative subpoena to Nvidia last week following revelations of Huang's affair with the woman who is alleged to have ties to China's Ministry of State Security.

## Congressional probes
Huang is [set to answer questions](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jensen-huang-congress-reinstatement-nvidia/) behind closed doors from lawmakers on three House panels, the Intelligence, Foreign Affairs and China Select Committee, on Dec. Nvidia's general counsel, Tim Teter, will appear before the committees on Dec.

House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries, who is expected to serve as House speaker in the next Congress, denounced the decision by Nvidia's board to reinstate Huang as "indefensible, irresponsible and incomprehensible."

"Congress will not be deterred from conducting a swift, thorough and wide-ranging investigation into business malfeasance by NVIDIA and corrupt abuse of power by Howard Lutnick and the Department of Commerce," he said in a statement Monday.

Huang, NVIDIA executives, and the company's board still owe Congress answers about the company's compliance with U.S. export controls," she said in a statement.

## Justice Department
The Justice Department and Commerce Department said in a [joint statement](https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/joint-statement-department-commerce-and-department-justice-megaspeed-investigation) earlier this month that the federal government had been investigating Megaspeed, the Singapore-based computing company that is a Nvidia client, since 2024.

The Commerce Department sought records from Nvidia in May 2025 about direct or indirect sales to Megaspeed and placed the Singaporean company on its "no sell" list that June.

Agents with the Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security, working with Singaporean law enforcement, conducted an on-site, in-person check at Megaspeed in June 2025 and interviewed Alice Huang, the Commerce and Justice Departments said in their statement. After that action, the Justice Department took the lead in the criminal probe into Megaspeed.

Nvidia has received a subpoena as a witness from the Department of Justice in relation to its investigation into Megaspeed and export controls, a source directly familiar with the situation told CBS News.

Megaspeed has denied wrongdoing and said Alice Huang left the company in August 2025. China has denied allegations that she is a spy.

Trump told reporters earlier this month that the FBI was "looking into" Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, who is of no relation. A Justice Department official said Monday that Attorney General Todd Blanche spoke with Mr. Trump about Jensen Huang and Nvidia over the weekend, and said "the DOJ has no evidence of any wrongdoing" by either Huang or his company.

At a press conference Tuesday, the attorney general said the Justice Department did not have any information showing Huang committed criminal acts, and if he had, Blanche "would have certainly told the president."

## Internal Nvidia probe
After the [New York Times reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/29/us/politics/nvidia-china-jensen-huang-trump.html) that Huang was the target of a potential Chinese intelligence operation, Nvidia's board announced earlier this month that it would be [launching an independent investigation](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-china-intelligence/) into the allegations and hired the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to help with the probe.

After announcing that Huang would return to Nvidia as president and CEO, the board said the investigation "will proceed to conclusion."

Huang fully supports the investigation and is committed to cooperating with it," the board said.

title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and ...
description:
# NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director
November 23, 2026

NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board. The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.

Harvey Jones will remain as Board chair.

“I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” said Jensen Huang. I can’t wait to get back to work.”

Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, the Board formed a committee comprised solely of independent directors to investigate, and the committee retained independent counsel to assist it in that investigation.

The Board also recently formed a National Security and Export Control Committee comprised solely of independent directors to oversee trade compliance and national security risks. NVIDIA will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations and inquiries.

WRIGHT-PATTERSON AIR FORCE BASE, Ohio (AP) — Vice President [JD Vance](https://apnews.com/hub/jd-vance) on Wednesday played down the possibility that Nvidia CEO [Jensen Huang](https://apnews.com/article/nvidia-megaspeed-china-singapore-huang-5403f152a601cf82ce939f1d24fffa0f) could need a presidential pardon just days before the executive of the AI giant is expected to appear before a congressional committee.

Vance told reporters that Justice Department officials and “multiple officials in our national security apparatus” have confirmed that Huang is “under no investigation.” The vice president made the remarks after having a [Thanksgiving Eve meal](https://apnews.com/article/vance-trump-thanksgiving-ohio-space-academy-b15211aafa25c8f5610bd5f39580ace0) with troops at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base.

The Nvidia CEO resigned earlier this month after acknowledging extramarital affairs, including one with a woman [suspected of being a Chinese spy](https://apnews.com/article/nvidia-jensen-huang-ai-affair-104bcfb52f724bdf15c4d460cfaba139). He [was reinstated 11 days](https://apnews.com/article/nvidia-jensen-huang-39d4b34ffaa867b4e669893b5fd5028f) later at the urging of President [Donald Trump](https://apnews.com/hub/donald-trump).

“I don’t think he needs a pardon at all,” Vance said. “I haven’t seen any evidence again that he committed a crime.

Trump also told the Post he doesn’t want Huang to invoke his Fifth Amendment rights under the U.S. Constitution to avoid self-incrimination amid potential criminal prosecution when he appears before lawmakers.

## The Nvidia case raises questions about the line between business and politics
Nvidia and the White House are also [facing scrutiny](https://apnews.com/article/nvidia-board-jensen-huang-reinstated-trump-7b0af450cb10c489ae00c51ae14af58a) about Trump’s relationship with Huang, a close adviser to the president on [artificial intelligence](https://apnews.com/hub/artificial-intelligence) issues.

The New York Times has reported that Trump had previously been briefed on intelligence concerns about the Nvidia CEO’s relationship with [Alice Huang](https://apnews.com/article/nvidia-jensen-huang-ai-affair-104bcfb52f724bdf15c4d460cfaba139), an executive at the Singapore-based company Megaspeed. U.S. officials suspected that she was working with China’s Ministry of State Security. [Beijing has denied](https://apnews.com/article/china-denies-spy-jensen-huang-nvidia-3345b9f05c54d58909e88f6dcb9c1cd8) it.
